scope: Revised A1 conditional within-observation exact reuse proof, concrete H7 candidate, build and targeted integration tests; individual proof review only

findings.statement: Revised observables cover precisely written valid-prefix rows; full output-buffer equality requires identical initial output bytes. Empty calls and rejected suffixes preserve their initial bytes. Source inspection and unequal-sentinel raw ABI checks confirm this disposition.

accepted_conditional_components: H7 ABI n=6,m=8,b=36 yields width112 and state167 doubles. Candidate dimension rejection precedes mutation; equivalence deliberately excludes other reference dimensions.

For positive current the hysteresis argument depends only on q; for negative current only on r. Immutable nonaliasing inputs and fixed rounding make eight stored exp/expm1 pairs sufficient for all64 positions.

Candidate preserves argument operand order, state expression grouping and row-major update order. SOC, RC and projection computations are unchanged. Induction applies to arbitrary finite admitted initial states and common chronological call partitions.
Both signs of zero current skip hysteresis. Both signs of zero dt with nonzero current preserve the same signed-zero arguments and updates under the stated arithmetic premises.

Validation predicates and valid-prefix mutation agree. The primitive remains nontransactional; MixedField stages state and rows before committing. Downstream equivalence remains conditional on identical consumers, ordering and their own runtime premises.

Value-equivalence explicitly excludes errno, floating flags/traps, timing, call counts and asynchronous faults. Fixed binary64 rounding, deterministic libm and no reassociation/contraction/excess precision remain premises, not universal portable C guarantees.
Source counts93/82 to37/26 exp/expm1 for nonzero current and29/18 at rest agree with separately instrumented host runs. These do not imply whole-estimator or target speedup.
Two local eight-double arrays have128B payload, expire within each observation, and do not change persistent formats or require cross-observation cache validity.
